notes:
Inbound from small B2B SaaS (Convergent Loop Labs) building an embedded, in-app chat assistant for customer success and guided workflows. Key points:
- Primary ask: streaming responses (SSE/websocket) w/ client-side typing UX; p95 latency target < 300ms for short responses, ideally < 200ms on NVidia inference.
- Traffic: expected initial concurrency ~30-80 sessions, bursts to 200 in peak demo days. Avg message length ~20-80 tokens.
- Cost sensitivity: early-stage — low ARR expectation (5k-25k), but wants predictable per-message economics; interested in Optimize recommendations (batching + cache hints).
- Security: prefer hosted API (public cloud) but must support SSO (SAML/OIDC) and basic audit logs; asked about data retention controls.
- Model preferences: open model variants OK, want fallback policy (smaller quantized model) when capacity constrained.
- Developer stack: React frontend + serverless API gateway; want simple SDK and streaming client examples.
- Quote from CTO Arjun: 'If we can't hit consistent sub-300ms p95 with streaming, we'll have to build our own lightweight solution.'
- Tech notes from SE: suggested 1) enable prefix caching for KB queries, 2) use continuous batching window 10ms for small requests, 3) consider 4-bit quantized for cost tests in Optimize.
- Risks: limited dev bandwidth (founder-led eng team), budget still TBD; security review could push to procurement if any residency or DPA issues.
- Stubs/links: Fireflies ffx_20260305_convergentloop_technical_deepdive, Gmail thread-f:CA+convloop-inbound-20260218, drive:/Sales/ConvergentLoop/pricing-proposal-v1.pdf.
- Sales pitch notes: emphasize streaming SDK, sample app that demonstrates p95 < 250ms on our hosted GPU pool, a 48h smoke run with telemetry for trust.
- Nexts: provide trial API keys + sample app repo, run 48h latency test on their sample traffic, schedule review call 2026-03-16 (30m).
notes_summary: Early inbound SMB. Building streaming in-app chat. Latency-critical (<300ms p95). Prefers hosted API on public cloud. Wants trial/benchmarks before committing. Security (SSO + audit logs) important. Budget small, timeline Q2 decision.
sales_playbook: Offer 48h hosted latency run + prebuilt React streaming example; include Optimize suggestions (batching/cache) and cost estimate; push low-friction SSO guide.
